info.name: LMS Authentication - Complete Test Suite
info.description: Complete member authentication suite: email signup/login, Google/Apple social login, Firebase phone OTP, email OTP reset, refresh tokens, password change, and sessions. Use a disposable test database/account.

request.description: Confirms whether the client-side Firebase configuration is complete and stores apiKey when available.

item.name: Duplicate signup should be rejected (known gap)

request.description: Desired behavior is 422. Current implementation logs the existing user in when the password is correct, so this test intentionally exposes the contract gap.
Paste a fresh Firebase ID token issued after Google sign-in.

exec: const json = pm.response.json(); if (json.data && json.data.token) pm.collectionVariables.set('access_token', json.data.token);

request.description: Legacy web OAuth flow using a Google OAuth access token.
Desired behavior is a clean 422 provider validation error.

item.name: 03 - Firebase phone OTP and mobile account

request.description: Firebase may require reCAPTCHA, Play Integrity, or an app-verification token depending on platform/configuration. Firebase test phone numbers are recommended for Postman.

item.name: Reset mobile password with Firebase token
Login mobile user with reset password

exec: pm.test('Login with new password succeeded', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Copy the six-digit code from the email into collection variable email_reset_otp.

exec: pm.test('Access token rejected for refresh', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
const json = pm.response.json(); const rows = Array.isArray(json.data) ? json.data : Object.values(json.data || {});
const current = rows.find(x => x.is_current) || rows[0]; if (current) pm.collectionVariables.set('session_id', String(current.id));

item.name: Change password and revoke all tokens
Old access token rejected after password change

exec: const json = pm.response.json(); const rows = Array.isArray(json.data) ? json.data : Object.values(json.data || {});
const current = rows.find(x => x.is_current) || rows[0]; pm.expect(current).to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set('session_id', String(current.id));
